About Us

## Welcome to Amit Cotton Industries

Since 1997, Amit Cotton Industries has been a trusted name in the cotton industry. Based in Gujarat, India, we are one of the leading manufacturers, exporters, and distributors of Raw Cotton and Cotton Yarn, specializing in Shankar-6 (Saurashtra) variety. With a TMC-approved automatic ginning plant and a daily production capacity of 1,200 bales, we deliver consistent quality to customers worldwide.

Over the years, we have built a strong global presence through our commitment to quality, timely delivery, and ethical business practices. Today, we are recognized among the most reliable suppliers of Conventional, BCI, and USDA Certified Organic Cotton.
